summary: The frequent typed owner tools (samantha_utility_billing, samantha_steg, samantha_sonede, samantha_topnet, samantha_maxit_tunisie, samantha_agenda, samantha_pulse) and samantha_catalogue are marked catalogMode "direct-only", the SDK's documented per-tool knob: OpenClaw Tool Search keeps them model-visible and out of its catalog. The other typed tools stay behind tool_search. No OpenClaw patch and no config key.
reason: S24 30/10 21:21 brain-only run_1793395301758_9b29ce1e (« Quel est l'état de mes factures »): with tools.toolSearch unset (SDK default mode tools, 110 tools cataloged) the brain could not see samantha_utility_billing; it batched a tool_search with a batch-level limit, which the SDK refuses (« set limit on each batch query, not on the batch request »), then ran the billing shell command (10.6 s). Total about 30 s.
